brief:
Gaza's Government Media Office accused Israel of breaching its commitments under the ceasefire agreement, according to Middle East Eye. Officials said continued violations have deepened the humanitarian crisis as winter approaches, raising alarm about an imminent disaster.

The accusations center on Israeli non-compliance with ceasefire terms, though the specific violations were not detailed in the available report. Gaza faces severe shortages of fuel, medicine, and shelter heading into colder months.

title: Gaza officials warn Israel violates ceasefire, threatening winter catastrophe
